name: Chemical Connoisseur
text: Your acute taste boosts your immunities. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against effects with the disease, ingested, olfactory, or poison traits. Any disease you contract with a level lower than your own loses the virulent trait.

name: Chew Through Wires
text: The quickest way to stop a machine, in your experience, is to bite it over and over. Your melee unarmed Strikes gain the razing trait.

name: Child of the Red Planet
text: Calling upon your birthright as a shobhad, you channel the spirit of your ancestral home world of Akiton to encase you in a forbidding aura that causes your enemies to shy away from you in fear. Clad in the glory of the red planet, none can stand before you! You can cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yrZA4k2VAqEP8xx7 once per day as a primal innate spell. Creatures from Akiton take a –2 penalty to their Will saves against this effect.

name: Chitinous Shield
text: You have a growth of particularly durable chitin on your arm that you can use as a shield. This shield doesn't need to be held in your hand, and it can't be disarmed. Your shield has an AC bonus of +2, Hardness 4, 12 Hit Points, and a Broken Threshold of 6. If your shield becomes broken, it can't be repaired until you are restored to full health and spend 10 minutes readjusting your chitin. You can spend 1 day of downtime and expend raw materials (such as UPBs) to improve the grade of your shield, but only to a grade up to your level (such as advanced if you're level 8 or higher). Use the level, price, Hardness, HP, and BT adjustments in the Shield Improvements table.

name: Chitterspam
text: By chittering out a hodgepodge of complex algorithmic computer code, you can disrupt technology attempting to process your words. You gain the skill feat. You can Combat Hack a creature with the tech trait within 30 feet without the use of a hacking toolkit or free hand. If you do, the action loses the manipulate trait and gains the auditory and linguistic traits.

name: Chosen Family
text: Traveling across the galaxy, you've formed a tight bond with your found family, absorbing some of their culture now as your own. You gain the Adopted Ancestry general feat, and you also gain one 1st-level ancestry feat from the ancestry you chose for the Adopted Ancestry feat.

name: Chosen of Nchak
text: Hylax's favor flows through you, and you can feel her calling out, offering you a gift. You spend 24 hours in prayer deep underground, under intense environmental pressure. The power of Hylax flows into your exoskeleton, thickening the plates, strengthening the flesh beneath them, and providing you with the ultimate protection. You gain resistance to all physical damage (except adamantine) equal to one quarter your level (minimum 1).

name: Cite the Deep Lore
text: You're one of the forlorn, and the centuries you've spent away from Castrovel have helped you understand how other species live and how to move among them without drawing undue attention. You become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the skill feat.

name: Clan Crystal Form
text: Your clan crystal glows and expands, coating you in the ores found in the crust of the planet you were born nearest to. You can cast twice per day as a 6th-rank primal innate spell. You resemble the statue found on your clan crystal when you do so. While in cairn form, increase the damage die size of your clan crystal weapon by one step, and double your resistance to laser weapons and effects with the light trait.

name: Claws of the Artist
text: Your work emphasizes the skilled manual dexterity and attention to detail required to create beautiful works of artistry. You gain the Specialty Crafting feat of your choice. Additionally, your background in artistry has left you with a keen eye for aesthetics that can often make your work more valuable to collectors. When you roll a critical success on Crafting to Earn Income, you gain the amount of currency listed for the task level + 2 and your proficiency rank.

name: Cleanse Spirit
text: Through your knowledge of traditional kasathan healing rituals and meditative practices, you've learned to cleanse the body and mind of the ill or troubled. You gain Cleanse Affliction and Sound Body as 4th-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.

name: Cleave
text: When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP with a melee Strike, you can immediately make a free melee Strike against another enemy within reach.

name: Clever Counterspell
text: You can use Counterspell as long as you have the foe's spell in your spell database (not just prepared). You must still expend a prepared spell that shares a trait with the triggering spell (other than concentrate, manipulate, or its tradition trait); the GM may allow an opposing-trait spell that logically counters it.

name: Clever Feint
text: You set up a devastating strike with a quick feint. You can use Deception to Feint as a free action before making a Strike; if your Feint succeeds, the target is flat-footed against your attack.

name: Clever Improviser
text: You've invented clever ways to get things done even without the right tools. You can attempt any action that requires a skill you are not trained in without taking the untrained penalty.

name: Climate Adapted
text: Your body adjusts to extremes. You gain cold resistance 2 and fire resistance 2, and treat severe temperatures as one step less severe.

name: Climbing Claws
text: You can extend your claws to aid you in climbing. You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed.

name: Climbing Specialist
text: Whether by natural appendages or by some personal modification, you can climb. You gain a climb Speed equal to your ancestry's Climbing Specialist entry.

name: Clinging Bite
text: You have excellent control over your stomach-mouth. Your jaws unarmed attack gains the grapple trait. When you critically hit with your jaws attack, you can use your next action to attempt to that creature with your jaws or automatically extend the condition on a creature you're restraining with your jaws. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward your multiple attack penalty.

name: Clinging Flare
text: Your flare wraps around your foes on impact, entangling them. Make a solar flare Strike. On a hit, the target is Immobilized until the end of its next turn or until it Escapes (against your class DC), whichever comes first. On a critical hit, the target is additionally Off-Guard for as long as it's immobilized.

name: Cloaking Companion
text: One action: your drone or turret activates a cloaking device and gains concealment until the start of your next turn. At level 14, the concealment lasts 1 minute.

name: Cloaking Field
text: You gain the Cloaking Field mod (armor or exocortex): it emits a cloaking field in a 5-foot emanation — creatures within become concealed and those outside become concealed to those within; you (and your drone) see through it unhindered.

name: Cloaking Field
text: Frequency once per hour You bend light and background vibrations around yourself, either through expertise or a bit of technological ingenuity, allowing you to avoid detection. You become Invisible for 10 minutes. This makes you Undetected to all creatures, though creatures can attempt to find you, making you Hidden instead. If you use a hostile action, the effect ends after that hostile action is completed. While your Cloaking Field is active, security cameras, sentries, and other surveillance don't detect you unless they possess special senses that normally see through invisibility.

name: Close the Gap
text: 1 or 2 Frequency once per hour You advance into danger, heedless of threats and intent on closing with your targets. Stride once, or Stride twice if you used two actions. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed for these Strides.

name: Cloud Form
text: You can transform yourself between your physical body and a body formed of vapors and mists. In this state, you're amorphous. You lose any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and use your proficiency modifier for unarmored defense. You gain resistance 10 to physical damage and are immune to precision damage. You can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. You move using your normal Speeds and can slip through tiny cracks like a Tiny creature regardless of your actual size. You can use this action again to return to your normal form.

name: Cloud Jump
text: Your unparalleled athletic skill allows you to jump impossible distances. Triple the distance you jump on a successful Long Jump (so you could jump 90 feet with an Athletics result of 30). When you successfully High Jump, use the distance jumped and distance limit for a Long Jump but don't triple the distance. You can jump a distance greater than your Speed by spending additional actions when you Long Jump or High Jump. For each additional action spent, add your Speed to the distance limit.

name: Cloud Storage
text: You can use your vitality network as an extradimensional storage space, sliding items into and out of thin air as if it were a Null Space Chamber. You can Interact with an item that weighs 1 Bulk or less to stow it into your Cloud Storage. A creature in your bond and on the same plane can remove an item from your Cloud Storage as an Interact action, but doing so takes 2 actions instead of 1 action. Your Cloud Storage has a capacity of 12 Bulk. This increases to 25 Bulk at 8th level, 50 Bulk at 12th level, and 75 Bulk at 16th level.

name: Cloud Walk
text: You can walk on clouds and fog as easily as on solid ground. This allows you to use your normal land Speed to Stride and Step on clouds, as well as otherwise move normally walking on clouds. The effect doesn't mean clouds are entirely solid barriers to you, however. You can move through clouds with parts of your body when you wish to, while still allowing the cloud to hold your weight. Effectively, this allows you to walk through or into clouds, or even scrabble up a cloud by walking upwards and treating the cloud like a set of stairs.

name: Clustered Shots
text: Requirements You're wielding a gun with at least 3 expend worth of ammunition. You shoot a spray of bullets at a target. You Aim, make a ranged Strike against your mark, and subtract three times your weapon's expend from its magazine. Roll the attack twice, and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being Concealed or Hidden.

name: Coagulation
text: Your blood coagulates into sludge, making your body more resilient against attacks that rip and shred. You gain resistance to bleed and precision damage equal to your level. The DC of your flat checks to recover from persistent bleed damage is 13 rather than 15. This reduces to 8 rather than 10 when receiving appropriate assistance.

name: Coastal Adaptation
text: You grew up in a colony that builds structures along the coast and in the oceans, and you've adapted to life underwater. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a swim Speed of 5 feet and the amphibious trait, allowing you to breathe underwater as well as in the air. Special If you take the Swimming Specialist ancestry feat, you gain a swim Speed of 30 feet instead of 20 feet.

name: Coat In Bile
text: Frequency once per day Requirements You're wielding a weapon that deals physical damage. You coat your weapon or its ammunition in your toxic stomach fluids, which remain potent until the end of your next turn. The next time you successfully Strike a creature with the required weapon within the duration, if the Strike deals damage, you deal an additional 1d4 poison damage to the target. At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1d4.

name: Code Talker
text: Your understanding of languages extends to the logic-driven way computers and other technology communicates, allowing you to participate in their electronic dialogue. You become trained in Computers. If you would automatically become trained in Computers (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the skill feat. You can use Computers instead of Diplomacy to Make a [[/act request skill=computers]] of creatures with the tech trait.

name: Cognitive Agility
text: You adjust quickly to changing circumstances in battle, whether from intense training or some intrinsic knowledge. As a result, you're able to shake off effects that are intended to distract or cloud the mind. You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against emotion effects and a +1 to your Perception DC against attempts to and .

name: Cold Endurance
text: Your thick fur is a shield against the cold. Your cold resistance increases to 8, and you don't suffer penalties from extreme cold environments.

name: Collateral Witness
text: Trigger You reduce your primary target to 0 Hit Points using Auto-Fire. With a subtle gesture of your weapon and a stare, you remind a survivor of your onslaught that there's more where that came from. Demoralize a single creature that was in the area of your Auto-Fire; you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. If you have legendary proficiency in Intimidation, or if you have the Action Hero fighting style and the target of Collateral Witness is the enemy closest to you, you can use this as a free action with the same trigger.

text: You channel the collaborative nature of Heaven, if you're a paradise dragon, or your communal life in large colonies, if you're a toadstool dragon, to more easily assist your allies. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on checks to Aid.

name: Collector
text: Everything in the world that's shiny needs a home, and everything in the world is shiny. You've found ways to create pockets in your fur, helping you to better conceal items you're liberating. You become trained in Thievery. If you're already trained in Thievery, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain Internal Compartment as a standardized ancestry feat.

name: Combat Climber
text: You can fight effectively while climbing. You're not flat-footed while Climbing and can use one hand to attack while the other holds a surface.

name: Combat Hack
text: Requirements You are holding or wearing a hacking toolkit and have a free hand. Attempt a Computers check to Hack an adjacent creature, hazard, or item with the tech trait. The DC is equal to the creature, item, or hazard's Fortitude DC, or the Fortitude DC of the creature attending the object. If the target is an unattended object, the GM sets the DC for the check based on the item's level. The target is temporarily immune to your attempts to Combat Hack it for 10 minutes. Critical Success The target becomes Glitching 2. Success The target becomes Glitching 1. Critical Failure If the target has the glitching condition, reduce the value of its glitching condition by 1.

name: Combat Reflexes
text: Your extensive training has transformed you into a living weapon, ready to pull the trigger at a moment's notice. At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain an additional reaction during that turn that you can use only for an operative reaction.

name: Combine
text: Frequency once per day You temporarily merge your body with that of an adjacent willing creature, overlaying yourself atop them to better shield them from harm. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this effect. When you do, you emerge in a space adjacent to the target you merged with. While combined, you and your target each take your own turns as normal and must be targeted separately for the purposes of abilities and other effects. Additionally, you and your target gain the following benefits. If the target is Medium or smaller, their size increases to Large and their reach increases to 10 feet. You occupy the target's space and can't take actions with the move trait. If the target moves, you move with them. For each Speed you possess, compare it to that of your target. If your Speed is faster, or they lack that Speed, they gain your Speed. Your body shields the target from harm, granting them greater cover, though you don't gain cover. Your body doesn't obscure the target's vision or block line of sight.

name: Come Get Some!
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points and would fall Unconscious. You fight on to the absolute last, pushing yourself to make one final attack at a foe. Make a Strike with a –2 circumstance penalty, or make an Area Fire or Auto-Fire attack ignoring the unwieldy trait and with the save DC decreased by 2. After the attack is concluded, you immediately fall unconscious and gain the Dying condition.

name: Comfortable Carrier
text: Your physiology and experience makes you relatively resistant to what makes other creatures nauseated. At the end of each turn you have the sickened condition, you can attempt to retch to reduce the value of your sickened condition as a free action. In addition, when you spend a single action to retch to reduce the value of your sickened condition, you can choose to retch toward an adjacent creature in an attempt to sicken them. If you're successful in reducing your sickened condition, the adjacent creature must attempt a Fortitude save against the same DC of the effect that gave you the sickened condition or your class DC, whichever is lower, becoming Sickened 1 on a failure or Sickened 2 on a critical failure.

name: Comfortable In Your Own Chitin
text: A lifetime living in a chitinous exoskeleton has given you rare insight on how to maneuver when wearing different types of armor, and your expertise only grows each time you shed and form an exoskeleton anew. You become trained in light armor and gain the armor specialization effect of light armor. If you're trained in medium or heavy armor, you gain the respective armor specialization effect of those armors as well.

name: Coming Through
text: You cruise around your adversaries at top speed. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You can [[/act tumble-through]] any number of enemies, not just one. Your movement ends only when you critically fail an Acrobatics check to Tumble Through an enemy's space (or when you lack the Speed to move all the way through its space). You still trigger reactions on a failure to Tumble Through.

name: Command Tactics
text: You're a skilled leader. Whenever an ally selects you as the target of their attempts to Follow the Expert, you increase the circumstance bonus they receive to their skill check by an additional +1, or an additional +2 if you have master proficiency or higher (for a total of +3 for expert, +5 for master, and +6 for legendary).

name: Commanding Height
text: You're taller than the average kasatha—which is saying something. Your height combined with your long limbs and natural dexterity allow you to target foes even when your allies are in the way. You ignore lesser cover when Striking an enemy with a ranged weapon if that lesser cover is caused by an ally.

name: Commanding Pheromones
text: You can leverage your alluring pheromones to soothe ill will and take the edge off your threats, turning your attempts at coercion into acts of leadership. When you Coerce a creature, if your target would become unfriendly (and they aren't already unfriendly or hostile), they become indifferent instead.

name: Commercial Customization
text: Your drone gains one commercial customization, granting it a new ability. Special: you can select this feat up to three times.

name: Communal Crafting
text: You can have other PCs help you Craft an item, under your direction. A helper PC rolls a check with a skill in which they're trained. The skill must be Crafting or another skill relevant to the item, as determined by the GM. For example, a PC might use Religion to help you Craft an item with the divine trait or Warfare Lore to help you Craft a weapon. Your roll still determines whether you successfully create the item. Any helper's roll contributes toward reducing the cost of raw materials using the numbers from the Earn Income table; this uses the ally PC's proficiency rank in the skill and their level – 1 for their level. Helping PCs must accompany you throughout the Craft activity (preventing them from pursuing other downtime activities) or the benefit is lost. The GM might determine that only a certain number of PCs can help depending on the circumstances. Communal Crafting also allo

name: Communal Memory
text: Your partial connection to collective consciousness allows you to draw on shared knowledge. Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes meditating to gain the benefits of having made a successful recall knowledge check on any one topic.

name: Communal Ward
text: Your bond extends protective energies. Bonded allies within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against effects that would separate them from the group or alter their mind.

name: Communalism
text: Frequency once per day Trigger An ally within 10 feet fails a skill check requiring 3 actions or fewer. You broadcast helpful encouragement or pertinent information to your ally's mind. Your ally rerolls the triggering skill check and takes the better result.

name: Community Raft
text: You lock arms with one or more adjacent allies as an Interact action, which supports them while swimming. Any number of additional allies equal to half your level (minimum 1) can lock arms with another ally in the raft as an Interact action. As an exploration activity, you can Swim at half your typical swim Speed and carry your allies with you. If you're using Community Raft at the start of an encounter, you and your interlocked allies can usually roll an Athletics check instead of a Perception check to determine your initiative. Any member of the Community Raft can stop locking arms at any time without spending an action. Allies can still use interlocked arms for other purposes, such as wielding weapons or using unarmed Strikes while part of a Community Raft. Special You can form a Community Raft in zero-g. All members of the raft lose the Untethered condition if at least one member of the raft does not have the untethered condition. If the raft is moved, every member of the raft floats at the same time. If every member of the raft is untethered, the entire raft floats at the end of each round rather than the end of each member's turn.

name: Compact Predator
text: You may be small, but your body is a dangerous weapon, sporting either long talons, razor-sharp teeth, or curving horns. When you select this feat, you gain your choice of a claw unarmed attack, a horn unarmed attack, or a jaws unarmed attack. These attacks are in the brawling weapon group. A claw unarmed attack deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the agile, finesse, ikeshti, and unarmed traits. A horn unarmed attack deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and has the disarm, ikeshti, shove, and unarmed traits. A jaws unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the grapple, ikeshti, and unarmed traits. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these attacks, you get its critical specialization effect. Special You can take this feat up to three times. Each time you do, select a different attack from the options above.

name: Competitive Spirit
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger An ally attempts a skill check with a skill that you have trained or better proficiency rank in. You push yourself to be the best by competing with the triggering ally. Until the end of your next turn, you can attempt the same skill check to perform the same action or activity that the triggering ally performed. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this skill check. If you achieve at least one degree of success higher than the triggering ally, this use of Competitive Spirit doesn't count toward its frequency. If you roll a critical failure on this skill check, you take a –1 circumstance penalty to all skill checks attempted with that skill for the next hour as you try new techniques to improve your future attempts.

name: Complete Transposition
text: The multiverse is a complex game—you use alternate realities to move creatures on the board. When you use the Sustain action to move your quantum field, you can teleport any number of creatures within the quantum field's original area to squares of your choice in its new area. You also teleport any items they're wearing or holding. This gives the Sustain action the teleportation trait. Each target can attempt a will|against:witchwarper|options:area-effect save against your class DC. Targets who succeed at the save are unaffected.

name: Compost
text: Frequency once per hour Your digestive enzymes can break down just about any organic material into food. You eject a spray of digestive enzymes in a , dealing |options:area-damage] damage plus 1d6acid damage for every 2 levels beyond 9th (to a maximum of 11d6 at 19th level), with a reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The digestive slurry remains liquid for 1 hour. As long as at least one living creature in the cone failed its saving throw, the slurry contains nutrients that you can absorb to restore your body. If you spend 10 minutes absorbing the liquid slurry through your roots, you regain ] Hit Points equal to 6 times your level.

name: Compressed Casting
text: [free-action] (once per day) If your next action is to cast a technomancer cantrip or a technomancer spell at least 2 ranks lower than your highest-rank technomancer spell slot, reduce its action cost by 1 (minimum 1 action).

name: Computer Whiz
text: You process digital information faster than most. You can access a computer with a simple interface as a move action (rather than a standard action) and reduce the time for all other computer tasks by half.

name: Conceal Spell
text: Through sheer mental effort, you can simplify the incantations and gestures needed to spellcast, leaving them barely noticeable. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, the spell gains the subtle trait, hiding the shining runes, sparks of magic, and other manifestations that would usually give away your spellcasting. The trait hides only the spell's spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects, so an observer might still see a ray streak out from you or see you vanish into thin air.

name: Concentrated Breath
text: You channel the fluids you expel into a concentrated blast of flame. When you use Fire Breath, you can choose to have it be a instead of a .

name: Concentrated Explosion
text: You gain the Concentrated Explosion mod (grenade): the grenade's area is halved (a 5-foot burst becomes one 5-foot square) but it deals one additional die of damage.

name: Concentrated Shot
text: Requirements You're wielding an automatic weapon. Focusing your fire enables you to target an enemy for immediate destruction. Make a ranged Strike with an automatic weapon, expending three times the ammo and gaining a +4 circumstance bonus to damage. This bonus increases to +6 at 11th level and +8 at 15th level.

When you gain this feat, choose a common polymorph spell with a battle form that matches your ancestry's creature entry; you can't change the form after making your choice. You can cast that spell as an 8th-rank innate spell once per day, except you must transform only into a battle form that matches your ancestral creature. Your form uses your normal AC if it's higher than what is granted by the battle form. If your ancestral creature isn't among the forms listed, you default to the statistics and abilities of the battle form that is closest to your creature at the GM's discretion. This spell has the same tradition as is listed in the feat entry. If you have the Ancestral Pest feat, you can choose to gain the effects of a 4th-level pest form.

name: Crevice Dweller
text: Whether burrowing underground, squeezing around branches in dense foliage, traversing the cramped back alleys of an urban jungle, or slipping through a starship's ventilation system, you know how to get through tight spaces. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the feat. Tight spaces not tight enough to require the Squeeze action aren't difficult terrain for you.

name: Crew Member
text: Trigger An ally within 30 feet attempts to Aid and rolls a failure. You're always able to help in a pinch. Attempt a skill check or attack roll of the same type attempted by your ally and replace the result of the failed Aid with your result, even if you didn't prepare to help.

name: Critical Explosion
text: Add your Intelligence modifier to your mines' damage. A creature that critically fails its save against one of your mines also takes persistent damage equal to your Intelligence modifier — persistent bleed if the mine dealt physical damage, otherwise the mine's damage type.

name: Cross Platform Application
text: You learn the initial magic hack of a programming language other than your chosen programming language.

name: Cross Research
text: A basic understanding of related topics has made you a better practitioner of your craft. You become trained in two Intelligence- or Wisdom-based skills of your choice.

name: Crowd Control
text: Your voice can be heard over the noise in a crowd. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks against crowds. The first time each round you Stride into a square containing a crowd, you can attempt a Diplomacy check to move the crowd out of your way. A GM might use a different DC under certain circumstances, such as when the crowd has a level or set DC to disperse. Critical Success As success, and the crowd departs from all adjacent squares as you move. Success The crowd disperses from squares you move into. Failure The crowd doesn't move, but you can continue moving. Critical Failure The crowd forcefully resists you and disrupts your Stride.

name: Crowd Surfing
text: You can move through crowds with ease. You can move through squares occupied by non-hostile creatures at full speed without needing to Tumble Through.

name: Crushing Fists
text: Your fists are exceptionally effective weapons. The damage die for your fist unarmed attack increases to a d6 and it gains the grapple weapon trait.

name: Cryogenic Touch
text: Your chill infuses your strikes. You gain a chill touch unarmed attack (1d6 cold, agile) and creatures struck by it are slowed 1 until the end of your next turn on a critical hit.

name: Crystal Attunement
text: Your crystalline structure absorbs energy more efficiently. Your electricity and sonic resistance each increase by 2.

name: Crystal Ball
text: Your foot orb has become a reflection of all of creation, allowing you to zoom in and project scenes from across the cosmos upon its crystalline surface. You can cast Scrying twice per day as a 6th-rank innate spell of the same tradition as the cantrip chosen for your jeweled orb bantrid heritage. Any visual information you receive through scrying this way appears within your foot orb, and any auditory information is emitted as sound out from the surface of your foot orb.

name: Crystal Resonance
text: Your crystalline body can emit a disruptive resonance. Once per day, you can emit a sonic pulse in a 15-foot cone dealing 1d6 sonic damage per 2 levels (basic Fortitude save).

name: Cue the Music
text: You know sometimes a good tune is the best way to start a brawl. When you roll Performance for initiative, you grant yourself and all allies who can hear you a +1 status bonus to their initiative rolls and to saves against emotion effects during the first round of the encounter. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.

name: Cultural Consumption
text: You can internalize a large amount of information when connected to the infosphere. When you successfully Access Infosphere about a specific organization, culture, or region, you can adopt facets of the culture you researched into your personality unit to mimic their habits and sensibilities. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Charisma-based skill checks against creatures related to the culture for 1 hour after you Access Infosphere. You can only adopt the facets for one group of creatures at a time, and if you adopt facets from a new group, the effects of a previous one immediately end.

name: Cultural Integrator
text: You've become particularly fascinated by a culture from a world other than Raxil and used your knack for integrating into a community to become part of that culture's traditions. You gain the Adopted Ancestry general feat as well as a 1st-level ancestry feat for your chosen ancestry.

name: Current Rider
text: You ride air currents, electromagnetic waves, and solar energy like a parachute. You take no damage from falling regardless of the distance you fall.

name: Cut 'Em Deep
text: Your insults and threats almost always hit the mark. When you roll a failure on a Demoralize action, you get a success instead. You can still critically fail. When you successfully Demoralize the target of your Get 'Em!, the target doesn't become immune to your further attempts to Demoralize them.

name: Cyber Storage
text: You've gone a step further than most and upgraded your body with built-in data access. You always count as having a comm unit available, even if you don't have a comm unit equipped. You can use a 1-minute activity, which has the manipulate trait, to integrate a single datapad into one of your arms. You can draw or stow this item as an Interact action. Creatures don't automatically see this integrated item when it's stowed and must actively [[/act seek]] to find it. They take a –2 circumstance penalty to any checks to do so. While you're wielding the item, it can't be Disarmed, and you can't drop or Release it; you must Interact to store the item and free that hand. A creature determined to retrieve the item can do so, but it requires either 1 minute to remove the item or extreme violence to your arm—such as physically removing portions of the limb. You can have only one integrated datapad at a time, though you can use the 1-minute activity to replace the datapad or swap the arm in which it's stored.

name: Cyclone
text: Requirements You aren't in a vacuum. You take inspiration from schools of hunting manta rays, creating a vortex to draw in your foe before striking. You spin in place and can attempt an athletics|against:fortitude check against the Fortitude DC of all creatures within 20 feet of you (or 40 feet if you and the target are in water). On a success, that creature is moved adjacent to you. On a critical success, it's also knocked Prone. If a creature is within melee reach of you after this check is resolved, you can Strike that creature.

name: Damaya Self-Perfection
text: Your embrace of the role of damaya helped you become a lifelong learner. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat twice and the Legendary Professional skill feat.

name: Damnation Flames
text: The fire of your breath consigns a creature's soul to Hell, damning it for all eternity. Any creature killed by your Dragon Breath is damned to Hell. In addition to the unpleasantness of their afterlife, it is much more difficult to raise a damned creature from the dead. Effects such as Raise Dead and Resurrect that would bring the creature back to life must first attempt to counteract your damnation flames, using your Dragon Breath's DC as the counteract DC.

name: Damoritosh's Claw
text: Frequency once per day Requirements You're engaged in combat. You pray to Damoritosh (or a battle saint) for a blessing in the heat of battle—and he answers. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.

name: Damoritosh's Grip
text: You have become a legendary soldier on par with the saints of Damoritosh and need not choose between the destructive power of your firearm and the honor of your personal armament. You can wield two-handed weapons in one hand.

text: You compel enemies to avoid your attacks by aiming at their legs, wings, or other forms of movement to make them easier to outmaneuver. When you Suppress a target with one of your attacks, it also becomes Off-Guard until the start of its turn. In addition, when Auto-Firing in a cone that affects only a single target, that target takes a –1 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves against the Auto-Fire attack.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find traps and Hidden, Undetected, and Unnoticed creatures; to AC against attacks made by traps and hidden, undetected, and unnoticed creatures; and to saves against traps. Even if you aren't Searching, you get a check to find traps that normally require you to be Searching. You still need to meet any other requirements to find the trap. If your initiative result is tied with an opponent, you always go first.

name: Daredevil
text: You get a rush from extreme stunts and wild antics. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you're already trained in Acrobatics, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain the Tuck and Roll reaction.

name: Daredevil Survivalist
text: Navigating the jungles of Castrovel is a task fit for an adrenaline junkie. When you attempt a Stunt while Piloting a vehicle, you reduce the penalty to your check by 1 (minimum 0).

name: Darkness Incarnate
text: You don the darkness like a mantle—a crown inherited from the black hole that bore you—and can disappear in its depths. Whenever you Absorb Light, you become Concealed until the beginning of your next turn. You can't use this concealment to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]].

name: Darkvision Adaptation
text: You've explored the darkest regions of space and found ways to adapt. You gain darkvision.

name: Data Bond
text: You can speak with computers. Any construct creatures you summon are considered part of your bond and don't count against the maximum number of creatures in your bond. During your daily preparations, choose one of the following spells: instant virus, mending, summon construct, or summon robot. You add the selected spell to your spell repertoire and signature spells until your next daily preparations.

name: Data Jockey
text: You can easily send data to technological devices like a spectra. You can cast the Implant Data cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Dauntless
text: You're rarely discouraged or afraid. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against fear and to your Will DC against attempts to Demoralize you. If you get a success on a save against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Dazzling Diversion
text: You concentrate ambient energy into a burst of light. Using the flash as cover, you use the Stealth skill to Hide, and then you Sneak up to twice.

name: Dazzling Glare
text: Through practice, you've learned how to increase the intensity of your bioluminescence. The range of your bioluminescence increases to 50 feet. Your dazzling glare misleads your foes, allowing you to use the Feint action against a creature within the range of your bioluminescence, rather than within melee range.

name: Dazzling Presence
text:
Frequency once per day

You surround yourself with alien energy that dazzles the senses of those nearby. For 1 minute, you gain a dazzling presence aura in a 20-foot emanation around you. Enemies who enter the aura (or are in the aura when you activate it) must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC with the following results. Afterwards, they are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is Blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute.

name: Dead Nerves
text: Without nerve endings, you can put your body up against hazards and obstacles without caring about bruising. Stride twice. Once during this movement, if you pass through or end adjacent to a door, window, wall, or similar obstacle, you can attempt an Athletics check to that obstacle with a +1 circumstance bonus to the roll. On a failure, your movement immediately ends.

name: Dead Worlds
text: You've expanded your planetary link and can reach out to a variety of planets. When you use Channel the World's Core the dice added to your next attack can be cold, electricity, fire, poison, or void damage instead of bludgeoning. The Strike gains the radiation trait if you choose poison.

name: Deadlift
text: Through focused training, you can lift enormous loads. Double your Bulk limit for the purpose of determining how much you can lift, though not carry.

name: Death Blossom
text: Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon with a full magazine. Spinning in place, you fire indiscriminately to completely clear out the room. You Area Fire (even if using an automatic weapon), affecting each creature in an emanation around you with a radius equal to the range of the weapon, expending the weapon's entire magazine. Creatures in the area take a –1 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves against this attack due to the cataclysmic nature of the raining fire. You don't designate a primary target with this attack.

name: Death March
text: You fight through conditions that would drop anyone else. You ignore the effects of the clumsy and enfeebled conditions while in combat, and you don't fall unconscious from the dying 3 condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Death's Advance

Your magically preserved corpse can plow through obstacles and ignore strain in ways the living cannot. Stride twice, or three times if you spent 3 actions to Death's Advance. During this movement, you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain. Once per day, you can choose to ignore all circumstance and status penalties to your Speed when you use Death's Advance.

name: Death's Indifference
text: Your skin and bones have weathered down to the point where certain types of damage no longer have the same effect on them as when you were counted among the living. You gain resistance to a specific damage type equal to half your level. Biting corpsefolk gain resistance to slashing damage, partial corpsefolk gain resistance to piercing damage, and shambling corpsefolk gain resistance to bludgeoning damage.

name: Death-Touched Caster
text:
You exist on the boundaries between life and death, and you can channel your own imbalanced spiritual essence into magical spells. Choose one of the following cantrips: Vitality Lash or Void Warp. You can cast this spell as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Special You can select this feat twice. Each time, you must select a different cantrip.

name: Deathless Study
text: Your long existence has given you time to train and insights worth several mortal lifetimes. You become trained in two skills of your choice.

name: Deathly Constitution
text: Thanks to your life-altering brush with death, your living body is better protected against the weaknesses of the flesh. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against disease and poison.

name: Debilitating Trick
text: When you use Aim and hit, you can apply one debilitating trick: Hampering (target is flat-footed), Hobbling (target's speed is halved), or Wounding (target takes 1d6 persistent bleed).

name: Debris Zone
text: Whether it's covered in debris, partially flooded, or otherwise troublesome to traverse, the area of your quantum field becomes difficult terrain.

name: Debris Zone

name: Debug Spell
text: [one-action] If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, any damage die that rolls lower than 2 becomes a 2 instead.

name: Deceptive Worship
text: You can feign religious devotion convincingly. You can use Deception to pass as a member of a faith and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to deceive religious organizations.

name: Deconstruction
text: Your knowledge of your own constructed anatomy, combined with your experience in combat, helps you take down other constructed foes with greater ease. Against constructs and robots, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage with weapon and unarmed Strikes equal to the number of weapon damage dice.

name: Decorated Peacekeeper
text: Your iconic armored silhouette has become a beacon of hope for the people you protect. As long as you are wearing armor with Peacekeeper Adornments, you can cast as an innate divine spell once per hour, heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level.

name: Dedicated Training
text: You ensure that you can dutifully perform your assigned role to the best of your abilities, whether that be for the Virtuum or for yourself. You gain a 1st-level class feat for your class. You must meet the prerequisites, but you can select the feat later in the character creation process in order to determine which prerequisites you meet.

name: Deep Breath
text: You can breathe in deep to deliver a more powerful breath, though it takes you longer to replenish afterwards. When you use Dragon Breath, you can choose to take a deep breath. If you do, your Dragon Breath deals twice as many d4s of damage as normal and increases the area to a 60-foot line if it was a 30-foot line, a 30-foot cone if it was a 15-foot cone, or a 10-foot burst within 60 feet if it was a 5-foot burst within 30 feet. You can't take a deep breath on your Dragon Breath again for 1d4 × 10 minutes.
